title: paired-priestley-space
description: A Priestley space equipped with an order-reversing involution (the swap) - the spatial dual of a distributive bilattice under Jung-Rivieccio duality, generated by adjoining the swap that encodes bilattice negation to a Priestley space.

swap.description: an involution sigma: X -> X on the underlying Priestley space, encoding the bilattice negation

swapOrderReversing.description: sigma is order-reversing: x <= y implies sigma(y) <= sigma(x)

swapInvolution.description: sigma is an involution: sigma(sigma(x)) = x for all x
